instruction: In the spreadsheet, add a formula in cell C2 that calculates the difference between the values in B2 and A2 (i.e., B2 minus A2).

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a formula in cell C2 that computes B2-A2. Verified with Python: B2 value is 0.2, A2 value is 0.1, so the difference is 0.1. Evaluator now properly checks both: (1) that cell C2 contains a formula (not just a literal value), and (2) that the formula is semantically correct (contains B2-A2 subtraction) and evaluates to 0.1.
